## About
Twins Mufflers and Tires is local, family-owned and operated, serving the East Mesa area from our shop on N Power Rd. We specialize in tires, custom exhaust systems and general auto repairs.
Stop in for new or used tires from brands like Michelin, Goodyear, Bridgestone and Toyo, plus wheel and rim packages, suspension work, oil changes and AC service. One customer wrote that Miguel fixed their car and it's running perfectly.
We're rated 4.5 on Google from 135 reviews. Give us a call or request service online, and we'll take care of you.

## Services
- New tires: A large selection of new or used tires from trusted brands, with help picking the right one for your car.
- Tire repairs: Got a flat or a damaged tire? Bring it in and we'll take a look.
- Tire rotation and balancing: Keep your tires wearing evenly and your car driving smoother.
- Wheel Packages for All Makes and Models: New wheel and rim packages in all colors, sizes and styles, including off-road wheels.
- Custom Exhaust System Services: Custom exhaust work plus repairs for mufflers, exhausts and catalytic converters.
- Suspension & Alignments: Suspension service to keep your ride handling the way it should.
- AC Service: AC system inspections, refrigerant recharge, component repair and replacement, blower and fan service, and filter replacement.
- Auto Repair: General auto repairs, including oil changes and suspension service tune-ups.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturdays?
A: Yes. We're open Saturday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM, and closed Sunday.

Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes, estimates are free. Call us or request service online.

Q: Do you sell used tires?
A: We do. You can choose from new or used tires.

Q: Is there 10% off an exhaust purchase?
A: Our site lists 10% off an exhaust purchase. Ask us about it when you call.
